listings.description:
Looking for a low-maintenance home in a highly convenient location? This beautifully renovated studio apartment offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and outstanding value. Thoughtfully designed to maximize both space and functionality, this unfurnished studio acts as a blank canvas, ready for you to personalize and make your own. With electricity, water, Wi-Fi, and garden maintenance all included in the weekly rent, this is an exceptional choice for a single professional, FIFO worker, or student looking for a stress-free lifestyle.

Important Information: Please note that Brisbane City Council regulations and fire safety requirements permit a maximum of one occupant per studio. As such, the property is not suitable for couples, families, or children. Pets are not permitted.

- All-Inclusive Living: Enjoy ultimate peace of mind with electricity, water, Wi-Fi, and garden maintenance all included in the rent!

- Premium Shared Amenities: Residents enjoy access to a spacious shared backyard with a covered entertaining area, a fully equipped communal kitchen with a dishwasher, and a shared laundry featuring two front-loading washing machines.

Location Features

- Exceptional Transit: Commuting is a breeze, located just 650m (approx.) from Deagon Train Station.

- Everyday Convenience: Only 850m to the local grocery store for all your daily essentials.

- Cafes & Dining: A quick 600m stroll to local cafes and fast-food outlets.

- Easy Commutes: Superb, straightforward access to the Gateway Motorway, plus close proximity to local parks and public transport routes.

If you are looking for an affordable, move-in-ready home in a fantastic and well-connected location, this renovated studio is one you won't want to miss!
